children: TransDigm Group announced its operating unit Extant Aerospace will acquire a portfolio of commercial rotorcraft, land systems and business jet assets for about $240 million in cash.
Extant Aerospace agreed to acquire assets including a California facility for approximately $240 million in cash.
The company disclosed the deal due to its total value, despite not typically reporting unit-level asset purchases.
The Acquisition is expected to close in TransDigm Group’s fiscal 2027, subject to regulatory approvals and customary closing conditions.
